Sacred Architecture Across Communities

A 90-minute discussion, online or at your campus

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this discussion you compare architecture without collapsing distinct practices and histories.

It is run as a guided conversation, online or on your campus, and works best with a group that is ready to argue a point.

What it covers

  • Compare plans and function
  • Different material traditions
  • Evidence-led terminology exercise
  • Respectful Q&A

How the time is spent

  1. Compare plans and function 15 min

  2. Different material traditions 25 min

  3. Evidence-led terminology exercise 30 min

  4. Respectful Q&A 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
